description: One streamed OpenAI chat answer with usage included, traced by the official OTel OpenAI instrumentation.
notes: Content is requested on spans: OTEL_SEMCONV_STABILITY_OPT_IN=gen_ai_latest_experimental and OTEL_INSTRUMENTATION_GENAI_CAPTURE_MESSAGE_CONTENT=span_only. The client sets stream_options.include_usage. The mock waits 120 ms before the first chunk and splits the answer into 4 chunks. The span has no gen_ai.response.time_to_first_chunk and no gen_ai.response.finish_reasons; this chat stream wrapper does not record per-chunk timing on the span.
